استطبقن (form X)
# اِسْتَطْبَقْنَ (istaṭbaqna) /is.tatˤ.baq.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَطْبَقَ (istaṭbaqa)
# اُسْتُطْبِقْنَ (ustuṭbiqna) /us.tutˤ.biq.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَطْبَقَ (istaṭbaqa)
# اِسْتَطْبِقْنَ (istaṭbiqna) /is.tatˤ.biq.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَطْبَقَ (istaṭbaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
